key_safety.text: The most common adverse reactions (incidence at least 4% and greater than placebo) are nausea, constipation, and fatigue. In Studies 1 and 2 nausea occurred in 5-9% of atogepant patients (vs 3% placebo), constipation 6% (vs 1%), and fatigue/somnolence 4-6% (vs 3%); no deaths and no serious adverse events with a clear association with atogepant.
